<thought>Using the molecular formula C7H12NO, the DBE (degree of unsaturation) is calculated with the formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. Substituting the values: 7 - 12/2 + 1/2 + 1 = 7 - 6 + 0.5 + 1 = 2.5, which rounds to the nearest integer DBE of 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
